preparation_failure: One initial CLI launch blocked before in-process app-server initialized; no usage available. The task tool output records the error; transport-probe logs were overwritten by its successful explicit retry. No holdout attempt was silently retried or overwritten.
limits: Onepass32questions, no prompt tuning onholdout; not general model superiority.
Accuracy is known-target retention/ranking and unrelated-query rejection, not exhaustive precision or whole-task success.
LLM wall time includes isolated CLI startup + one selection inference; not marginal latency measured inside an existing working turn.
Both LLM arms have one request even on empty candidates, to keep paired callcounts comparable; production may skip pure selection calls when no candidates.
Qwen cold model load+score+exit included; no ten-minute idle-retention implementation was benchmarked.
Input token usage includes shared Codex system overhead; cached-input/cache-write are subsets of input, reasoning is a subset of output.
Actual subscription charges/Codexcredits/provider fees are unavailable; token or time differences are not monetary savings.
No final context-budget packing or downstream answer/work execution was scored; direct LLM saw all full candidate texts.
One66-second raw-LLM outlier had no stderr error; queueing, CLI/transport delay and provider-internal retries cannot be separated from recorded wall time.

verification.rerun_guard_observed: existing attempt was refused before new inference
verification.independent_recomputation: all input hashes, metrics, timing, ID validity,64 event usage records and subset relations matched

semantic_review.finding: A different directly relevant record was ranked before the known target; the rank metric differs, but this does not establish a substantive selection error.
semantic_review.extras: Some complement the known target and others concern adjacent dates or attempts; selection count alone is not exhaustive relevance precision.
